Developer tools that run locally.

Rusk builds software for developers who want to work with models on their own hardware. We design around the tools developers already use and the machines they already have.

Products

Tessera brings local code completion and chat to VS Code. It selects a compact model for the language you’re editing.

Company

Rusk is the company behind Tessera. Our work starts with a practical question: how much can a developer tool do on the machine already running the editor?
